title: Check the applied Marketplace Details popups

steps.path: Confirming the matching edge you selected for skills
steps.hint: Scroll inside the skill content to its end; scroll outside the popup to switch between Before and Applied. Open in New Window for the full height.
steps.headline: Does the applied skill Details header match your choice?
steps.risk: Civic Report is Workbench sample data. The change is limited to the outer Details shell; the skill name, actions and nested file viewer remain separate.

variants.label: Before (for reference)
variants.summary: Original 18px semibold Details header, full-width divider and bare content scrolling.

variants.label: Applied skill Details
variants.summary: Actual 16px medium Details header, 8% tapered divider and conditional 42px/4%-side content fade.

steps.path: Confirming the matching edge you selected for themes
steps.hint: Compare the outer Details header above the theme name; scroll inside the body to check that more content remains legible.
steps.headline: Does the applied theme Details header match your choice?
steps.risk: Golden Sunbreak is Workbench sample data with its preview image. Applying a theme, installing and voting are not part of this styling change.

variants.label: Before (for reference)
variants.summary: Original 18px semibold Details header, full-width divider and bare content scrolling.

variants.label: Applied theme Details
variants.summary: Actual 16px medium Details header, 8% tapered divider and conditional 42px/4%-side content fade.
